stemMd: All portable lamps are rechargeable. No rechargeable device is disposable. Which conclusion necessarily follows?

options.label: B
options.textMd: All rechargeable devices are portable lamps.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some disposable devices are portable lamps.

explanationMd: Portable lamps belong to the rechargeable class, which has no overlap with disposable devices. The portable-lamp class therefore has no overlap with disposable devices.

distractorRationale.a: The converse inclusion is not given.
distractorRationale.d: The premises do not establish nonexistence.
